h: Kano Hisbah reportedly detains TikToker and two other women over dance videos
p: The Kano State Hisbah board has reportedly detained a TikToker, Amani Ishaq, and two other women over dance videos it considers immoral. The agency enforces Islamic moral rules in the state. It has not said what will happen next, according to the reports seen so far.
more: Hisbah has made similar arrests of content creators in the past.
Reaction on social media has been mixed.
